description:
ScreenshotOne: https://screenshotone.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=sponsorship&utm_campaign=eliezer_steinbock
Flue: https://flueframework.com/
Sandcastle: https://github.com/mattpocock/sandcastle
Inbox Zero: https://getinboxzero.com

Two new TypeScript AI agent libraries dropped recently: Flue by the Astro team and Sandcastle by Matt Pocock. I walk through both, then show why I built my own agent harness for Inbox Zero instead.

0:00 - Two New TypeScript AI Agent Libraries
1:00 - Flue: Cloudflare-native Agent Framework
5:40 - Sandcastle by Matt Pocock
8:00 - Why I Built My Own (Linear to PR Workflow)
10:50 - Final Thoughts

If you'd rather use a library than write your own, Flue and Sandcastle are both worth a look. Otherwise, this video shows the seven steps I wired up myself.

===================
My open source product, Inbox Zero:
Inbox Zero organizes your inbox, drafts replies in your voice, and helps you reach inbox zero fast. Never miss an important email again.
https://getinboxzero.com
GitHub: https://github.com/elie222/inbox-zero ⭐
===================

Follow me on X: https://x.com/elie2222
Join the Newsletter: https://aiopensource.substack.com/
